name: target
doc: Options on the thing under the crosshair. The raycast, zones and models stay with the targeting library (ox_target, qb-target): it opens this with the options it found and updates them as the target changes. Drawn by an eye at the centre and a `menu-row` list beside it. Resolves with the chosen option, or nil when targeting stops.

title.doc: The target's name, above the list.

eye.doc: Show the eye at the centre of the screen.

active.doc: Something is under the crosshair: the eye lights up.

open.doc: The list is shown (the player pressed the key).

id.doc: Returned in the result. Default: the 1-based index as a string.
